SELECT CLUBBOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CLUBBOARD (BOARDNUM, TITLE, CONTENT, REGDATE, VIEWCOUNT, STUDENTID, CLUBNUM) VALUES (#{boardNum}, #{title}, #{content}, SYSDATE, 0, #{studentId}, #{clubNum})
mapper.update: UPDATE CLUBBOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content} WHERE BOARDNUM = #{boardNum}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT B.BOARDNUM, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE, B.VIEWCOUNT, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBBOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = B.CLUBNUM ORDER BY B.BOARDNUM DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT B.BOARDNUM, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE, B.VIEWCOUNT, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBBOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = B.CLUBNUM ORDER BY B.BOARDNUM DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT B.BOARDNUM, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE, B.VIEWCOUNT, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBBOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = B.CLUBNUM WHERE B.STUDENTID = #{studentId} ORDER BY B.BOARDNUM DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT B.BOARDNUM, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE, B.VIEWCOUNT, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBBOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = B.CLUBNUM WHERE M.STUDENTID = #{studentId} ORDER BY B.BOARDNUM DESC
